# SBadge `<s-badge>`

A small label that shows the status of an object, such as an order, payment or fulfillment. `SBadge` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-badge>` web component.

```ts
import { SBadge } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Pick the size for the context.** Use `size="base"` in table cells, list items, or anywhere several badges sit together. Reserve `size="large"` for a single badge that deserves emphasis, such as the main status shown at the head of a page.
- **Keep labels to one or two words.** Short labels like "Fulfilled" or "Out of stock" scan quickly. Write statuses in the past tense, so "Refunded" rather than "Refund".
- **Match the tone to the status.** Use `tone="critical"` for errors or urgent issues that need action, `tone="warning"` for problems that need attention, `tone="success"` for positive confirmations, and `tone="info"` for neutral statuses. Give the same status the same tone everywhere in your app.
- **Keep badges next to what they describe.** In a list item, put the badge near the title. In a table, give badges their own column so merchants can scan it.
- **Use badges only for system statuses.** Badges are static indicators set by the system, so don't use them for tags merchants create or for items they can remove.

```vue
<SBadge tone="success">Fulfilled</SBadge>
<SBadge tone="warning">Partially refunded</SBadge>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-badge>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/feedback-and-status-indicators/badge#best-practices) for the full guidance.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `"base" \| "strong"` | Controls the visual weight and emphasis of the badge. - `base`: Standard weight with moderate emphasis, suitable for most use cases. - `strong`: Increased visual weight for higher emphasis and prominence. |
| `icon` | `"color" \| "info" \| "adjust" \| "affiliate" \| "airplane" \| "alert-bubble" \| "alert-circle" \| "alert-diamond" … (553 more)` | An icon displayed inside the badge to provide additional visual context or reinforce the badge's meaning. Accepts any icon name from the icon library or a custom string identifier. |
| `size` | `"base" \| "large" \| "large-100"` | The size of the badge. - `base`: Default size suitable for most badge use cases. - `large`: Larger badge for increased visibility and prominence. - `large-100`: Extra large badge for maximum visibility in emphasized contexts. |
| `tone` | `"auto" \| "neutral" \| "info" \| "success" \| "caution" \| "warning" \| "critical"` | The semantic meaning and color treatment of the component. - `info`: Informational content or helpful tips. - `success`: Positive outcomes or successful states. - `warning`: Important warnings about potential issues. - `critical`: Urgent problems or destructive actions. - `auto`: Automatically determined based on context. - `neutral`: General information without specific intent. - `caution`: Advisory notices that need attention. |

> Some type columns above are truncated for readability; the full union is available in the library's generated TypeScript types (`src/lib/generated/types.ts`).

| Slot | Description |
